description.value: Green & Oak is a locally owned Malaysian and Singaporean restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby, recognized with awards from Restaurant Guru, restaurantji, and Eating Vancouver for its authentic cuisine and warm hospitality. The menu spans traditional Southeast Asian dishes including Hainanese chicken, satay skewers, and Roti-Canai, drawing on the culinary heritage of both Malaysia and Singapore. The restaurant has cultivated a loyal following and received positive reviews for food quality and attentive service.
